name: Carlos Rivera
bio: With over 20 years in the pool industry, Carlos founded Summer Splash to bring top-tier pool services to Florida communities. His passion for clean water and happy clients drives everything we do.

name: Amanda Foster
bio: Amanda oversees daily operations and ensures every job meets our high standards. Her background in hospitality management makes her an expert at client satisfaction.

name: Derek Washington
bio: A certified pool operator with extensive renovation experience, Derek leads our technical team. No pool problem is too complex for his expertise.

name: Jessica Nguyen
bio: Jessica manages our commercial client relationships and custom maintenance programs. She ensures every commercial property receives personalized attention.
